text_block_list.text: I went out shopping together with Maruzensky.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I caught myself humming along.
The song playing on the radio sounded really nice, you see.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You know, that upbeat, trendy vibe that young folks love?
I totally adore that kind of thing too♪

text_block_list.name: Radio Host
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, what a nostalgic voice that was.
Please tune in next time for more hit songs of the era."

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
"N-No way, that was an oldie...?
It really struck a chord with me, though..."
